keySentence: She floated on a leaf alone.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: She was on the water. She missed her home. A butterfly came. She floated on a leaf alone.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The lily pad carried Thumbelina down the winding stream. She floated on a leaf alone, missing her mother. A kind butterfly flew beside her to keep her company. The water moved slowly and the world seemed so big. Thumbelina felt small and lonely on the open water. She did not know where the stream would take her.
facts.Word cards: toad = 두꺼비 / away = 멀리 / pond = 연못 / lily pad = 연잎
